snippet.title: Deep Rock Galactic - Seasons Ahead Teaser
snippet.description:
The news is out. Season 07, Season 08, AND a new Expansion DLC are officially confirmed for Deep Rock Galactic. It’s been a long time in the making, and means loads of new content coming to Deep Rock Galactic within the next year.

Read more details on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/548430/view/716791574974955739

--------------------
DEEP ROCK GALACTIC is a co-op-first sci-fi FPS featuring badass space Dwarves, 100% destructible environments, procedurally-generated caves, and endless hordes of alien monsters.
--------------------
Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/548430
Microsoft Store: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productId/9NHFVWX1V7QJ
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/233449/
